assumptions_challenged: That adherence to MISEV2023 guidance alone is sufficient evidence to advance—i.e., program-specific implementation is in place
That existing rodent intranasal biodistribution/efficacy data for SGL-001 (or analogs) predict intact-EV CNS exposure in larger species without matched intact-EV assays and controls
That validated intact-EV release and biodistribution assays (with LLOQ, specificity, precision) already exist for SGL-001
That an MCB/WCB has been produced and characterized to submission-grade standards for SGL-001
That reproducible release, stability, and potency across ≥3 GMP-like batches has been demonstrated for SGL-001
falsification_conditions: Provide Master Cell Bank (MCB) and Working Cell Bank (WCB) characterization documents (identity, adventitious agent testing, stability, storage records) meeting regulatory expectations

Provide fit-for-purpose validation reports for the orthogonal QC panel and intact-EV release assays showing LLOQ, specificity (distinguishing vesicles from non-vesicular particles), accuracy, precision (intra/inter-assay), and robustness

Provide validated intact-EV-specific biodistribution/quantitation assay reports (demonstrating signal derives from intact vesicles versus soluble/particle contaminants) with LLOQ and precision metrics

Provide stability study reports and a stability‑indicating potency assay development dossier that includes evidence of correlation between the potency assay and an in vivo PD endpoint (statistical correlation, study reports, methods)

Provide manufacturing and comparability data from ≥3 GMP-like batches (release results, critical quality attributes, stability data, and head-to-head comparability analyses) showing reproducible identity, purity, and potency

Provide GLP intranasal biodistribution/toxicology bridging study report(s) in a larger species using the validated intact-EV analytics and including appropriate positive and negative controls and raw data to attribute tissue signals to intact EV
strongest_objection: The program is proceeding toward comparative lot/formulation and intranasal bridging studies without any program-specific, submission-grade CMC and analytics evidence that would attribute in vivo signals to intact EV and demonstrate reproducible potency across lots; the cited MISEV2023 guidance supports what must be done but is not evidence that it has been done for SGL-001.
